countries.name: Ukraine
countries.notes: Ukrstat could not be reached (ukrstat.gov.ua: connection refused/timeout from curl and WebFetch; stat.gov.ua reachable but no regional crop-area table found). ipad.fas.usda.gov live site returned HTTP 503 / was blocked, so USDA FAS IPAD pages were read through Internet Archive snapshots (Dec 2024). National: IPAD country summary, production 5-yr average 2019-2023 (1000 t): corn 33,562; wheat 26,420; sunflowerseed 15,160; barley 7,970; soybean 4,120; rapeseed 3,496. Only these six field crops are covered: potatoes, sugar beet, vegetables and fruit are NOT covered by the source and may be regionally important. Regions: IPAD 'Crop Production Maps' (source stated on maps: State Statistics Service of Ukraine, average production 2016-2020), six map images (Ukraine_wheat/Corn/Barley/Sunflowerseed/Soybean/Rapeseed.jpg) giving each oblast's % of national production. Oblast ranking = oblast share x national production of the crop (national weights from the 2019-2023 summary, a different period than the shares). Shares are whole percentages, so close ranks within an oblast are uncertain; a crop absent from an oblast list had no percentage printed on the map. By production, not area: maize is favoured over sunflower/wheat relative to an area ranking (higher yield). The 10 oblasts with the largest derived output are listed. Data are pre-2022; war-affected oblasts (Kharkivska, Zaporizka, Khersonska, Mykolaivska) have changed since.

countries.notes: National: Defra 'Agricultural Land Use in United Kingdom at 1 June 2025' (wheat 1,670 kha, barley 1,080, maize 274, oilseed rape 241, potatoes 127, dry peas 60); that page gives no figures for oats or field beans, whose position (5th, 6th) is taken from Eurostat apro_cpsh1 UK 2019 (oats 182 kha, broad/field beans 137 kha; last UK year in Eurostat) - https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/api/dissemination/statistics/1.0/data/apro_cpsh1?format=JSON&lang=EN&geoLevel=country&sinceTimePeriod=2018 . Temporary grass (about 1.2 Mha in Eurostat 2019) is NOT in the national list because the Defra page read gives no figure. Defra 'maize' is mostly forage/biogas maize, mapped to maizefor (not split from grain maize). English regions (former Government Office Regions): each region page's Table 1.2 'Crop areas in 2025' lists only the predominant crops in absolute kha; the remaining positions were derived as region share of England (summary page Table 1.2, %) x England totals read in the region pages (wheat 1,525; barley 742; maize 241; oilseed rape 204; oats 162; sugar beet 93; potatoes 90; field veg 79 kha). Sugar beet share is published only for East of England (65%) and East Midlands (23%); field beans, peas and temporary grass are not in these profiles, so they are missing from English regional lists. North East and North West omitted (small crop areas). Scotland: Scottish Agricultural Census June 2024, Table 1 of the ODS tables workbook linked from the documents page (barley 300 kha, rotational grass <5 years 157 kha -> grassnes, wheat 98, oilseed rape 37, potatoes 29, oats 28). Wales: June 2024 survey ODS linked from the cited page (maize 24.5 kha, barley 24.0, wheat 22.7, stockfeed crops 14.9, oilseed rape 6.0, potatoes 2.9). Northern Ireland: DAERA June 2024 census news release (spring barley 13.6 kha, wheat 8.0, potatoes 3.1, oats 1.8; winter barley area not stated); forage maize/arable silage not given on the page read. Eurostat has no UK regional crop data for 2020+ (all empty).

countries.notes: Rosstat could not be reached (rosstat.gov.ru and territorial sites NN.rosstat.gov.ru: connection refused/timeout; fedstat.ru HTTP 403). ipad.fas.usda.gov live site returned 503, so USDA FAS IPAD pages were read via Internet Archive snapshots (Dec 2024). No entry is given for individual subjects (Krasnodar, Rostov, Stavropol, Altai, etc.). National: IPAD country summary production 5-yr avg 2019-2023 (1000 t): wheat 83,524; barley 20,015; sunflowerseed 15,500; corn 15,161; soybean 5,244; rapeseed 3,176; oats (4.5 Mt) and rye (2.0 Mt) positions come from the IPAD map averages 2017-2021. Regions: IPAD crop production maps (source stated: Rosstat, average crop production 2017-2021), images Russia_Total_Wheat, Total_Barley, Corn, sunflowerseed, Soybean, Total_Rapeseed, Oats, Rye; district ranking = district % of national production x national average printed on each map (wheat 78.2 Mt, barley 19.0, corn 13.6, sunflower 13.4, oats 4.5, soybean 4.2, rapeseed 2.2, rye 2.0). By production, not area. Districts with no percentage on a map are treated as negligible for that crop: Far East shows only soybean (38%), Urals and Northwest lists are short; these three are low confidence. Corn and sunflower maps show no % for Siberia/Urals.
